title: Buy CAPIT | Contract Details, Risks, and How to Buy
description: What the CAPIT token is and is not, the risks of buying it, how to confirm the contract address, and the steps to buy with a self-custody wallet on Base.
headline: Buy CAPIT
body: CAPIT is a community token with meme characteristics on the Base network. Its price depends on attention and demand, not on the registry or on wells being plugged. You never need it to use CAPIT's data. If you choose to buy, read the risks below and confirm the contract address first.

sections.heading: Before You Connect
sections.body: Make sure your wallet supports the Base network, that you understand how token swaps work, and that you are ready to review each transaction in your wallet before signing. You don't need a wallet to browse CAPIT's data. You only need one to buy or hold the token.

sections.heading: What This Token Is, and Is Not
sections.body: Before anything else, so there is no confusion about what you would be buying:
bullets: **It is** a community token. Its value comes from attention and demand.
**It is not** a carbon credit, an emissions offset, or a share of anything.
**It does not** give you ownership of a well, any environmental attribute, or any right to public remediation funds.
**It is not needed** to read, search, download, or build on CAPIT's data, which is free to everyone.
**It does not, today, unlock anything.** See [What does holding CAPIT do?](/faqs)

sections.heading: Understand the Risks
sections.body: Read these before you buy. Nothing on this page is investment advice.
bullets: Tokens like this commonly lose most or all of their value. Never spend more than you can afford to lose.
Token prices can fall, and you can lose the full amount you spend.
Trading volume may be low, so you may not be able to sell when you want or at the price you expect.
Blockchain transactions are final. CAPIT cannot reverse, cancel, or refund them.
Swaps take place on a third-party exchange that CAPIT does not control.
Smart contracts can contain undiscovered errors.
Holding CAPIT gives no ownership of any well, no share of any revenue, and no right to public funds.

sections.heading: Security Reminder
sections.body: CAPIT will never ask for your secret recovery phrase, private keys, or wallet password. If any page, prompt, or support message asks for them, stop immediately.

sections.heading: How to Buy
sections.body: Follow these steps in order. CAPIT cannot recover wallets or reverse transactions.
bullets: Connect a self-custody wallet that supports Base.
Switch your wallet to the Base network.
Copy the CAPIT contract address from this page.
Open the buy flow and paste the address to select CAPIT.
Review the amount, price impact, and network fee.
Approve the token spend if your wallet asks you to.
Confirm the swap and wait for the transaction to confirm.
Check the finished transaction on the block explorer.

sections.heading: Troubleshooting
sections.body: Common messages and what to do:
bullets: **Wallet not found:** install or unlock a wallet that supports Base, then reload the page.
**Wrong network:** switch your wallet to Base.
**Insufficient balance:** you need enough ETH on Base to cover the swap amount and the network fee.
**Transaction rejected:** the transaction was declined in your wallet. Start again when you're ready.
**Swap failed:** the price may have moved. Check your balance and slippage setting, then try again.
